attachments_metadata.notes: two Attachment and three Metadata records (one duplicated name) between indexed chunks

boundary_times.notes: log_time 0 in the first chunk and 2^63 in the last; exercises inclusive start / exclusive end

empty_channels_and_chunk.notes: channels with zero messages; a message-less first chunk; a late Schema/Channel pair declared in the last chunk

mixed_unchunked_tail.notes: three Message records live outside chunks after the last indexed chunk

multi_lz4_shuffled_index.notes: lz4 chunks; Chunk Index records appear in the Summary in shuffled order; no Summary Offset section

multi_zstd.notes: zstd chunks; 3 channels (one schemaless); cross-chunk out-of-order and duplicate log times

no_message_index.notes: Chunk Index records have empty message_index_offsets and message_index_length 0

no_statistics.notes: Summary section carries Schema, Channel, ChunkIndex and SummaryOffset records but no Statistics record

no_summary.notes: chunked and message-indexed but the Footer points at no Summary section

overlap_heavy.notes: chunks alternate channels with overlapping time ranges and identical timestamps across chunks

unchunked.notes: Schema/Channel/Message records written directly to the Data section; Summary has no Chunk Index

uncompressed_pad.notes: no compression; Header/Schema/Channel/ChunkIndex/Statistics/SummaryOffset records carry unknown trailing bytes

unknown_compression.notes: single chunk whose compression field is "bz2"
